mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous 6 months signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the previous 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over the previous quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% during late-cycle expansion.
